title: Authentication
intro: Customers and technicians sign in with email or phone and password, with a Firebase ID token (phone OTP / Google) or with an email OTP; administrators sign in with a password followed by an email OTP (2FA). auth-service owns the credentials and issues a JWT access token (24 h) and a hashed, revocable refresh token (30 days); roles are read from user-service.

title: Locker Incident Ticket
intro: A customer who cannot use a box reports it from the order. The box goes to PENDING_CHECK, a ticket is created and routed to the technician responsible for the locker, and the order is paused (no overtime). The technician claims the ticket within the SLA, adds notes and before / after photos, then resolves (box returns to service) or rejects it.

title: AI Assistant (RAG)
intro: Users ask questions in Vietnamese about Lock.R. assistant-service normalises the question, embeds it with Voyage AI, searches the kb_chunks vector index (pgvector, cosine) limited to documents allowed for the user's roles, adds the user's own order context when relevant and asks Claude for an answer with citations; it refuses when nothing relevant is found. Administrators upload knowledge documents that are chunked and embedded in the background.

title: System Scheduled Jobs
intro: Background jobs keep orders and boxes consistent: cancel unpaid orders, release boxes of completed orders, remind receivers before the pickup deadline, move overdue parcels to storage (EXPIRED), reconcile box states with locker-service and retry point refunds. Administrators can trigger them manually and see their status.
